info.text:
Maersk's operating profit fell 87% in one year: $30.9B in 2022 to $3.9B in 2023.
Ocean freight was $35.0B of Maersk's $54.0B revenue in 2025.
Shipping a 40ft box averaged about $1,420 in 2019 (Drewry) and hit $10,377 in Sept 2021, while ships, crews and port fees are largely fixed.
Operating profit per revenue dollar: 38 cents in 2022, about 6.5 cents in 2025. In Aug 2026, Maersk raised its outlook as rates jumped again.
Sources: Maersk results 2019-2026; Drewry World Container Index.

Operating profit was 38 cents per revenue dollar in 2022 and about 6.5 cents in 2025, and Maersk raised its 2026 outlook in August as rates rose again (Maersk results).
